name: ponchik_tilt5_a
prompt: Game sprite sheet: 8 animation frames of ONE smooth bench-press push from the lowest point up to the top, in a grid of 2 rows x 4 columns, read left to right, top row first, generous empty space between frames, never mirror a frame. The FIRST reference is the existing animation of the fat black-and-white tomcat Ponchik pressing a barbell: use EXACTLY this character, this camera angle and this body pose (lying on his back at an angle: the head at the upper right, the hips at the lower left, legs bent and down to the floor). The SECOND reference is the lowest point: keep the head, body, belly, legs and feet exactly like it. The THIRD reference shows the barbell and its tilt: the barbell is only SLIGHTLY tilted, about 5 degrees, its RIGHT end (on the side of his head) a little LOWER than the left end, EXACTLY the small angle of the THIRD reference (not more), the same tilt in all 8 frames. His fists grip the stick between the can bundles, about shoulder width apart, the right fist a little lower than the left one along the stick. Frame 1 is the lowest point: the barbell just above the chest under the chin, the elbows bent and dropped beside the body; frames 2-8 push the barbell straight up in small, EVEN steps without turning it; frame 8 is the top: the arms extended up with the elbows only a little bent. VERY IMPORTANT: everything except the arms and the barbell stays EXACTLY the same in all 8 frames as in the SECOND reference: the same position, height, size and angle of the head, body, belly, legs and feet; the body never moves up or down. The arms keep their length and thickness (short chubby arms, never stretched). The barbell is the same size in every frame (as long as in the FIRST reference), fully visible, it never covers the face. The SAME grumpy facial expression in all 8 frames. Comic book style exactly like the references. IMPORTANT: no bench, no floor line. IMPORTANT: the background of the whole sheet MUST be solid flat pure chroma-key GREEN (#00FF00) everywhere, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no frame numbers. Do not use green on the character.
